modelName: 2-feature linear reranker (exact-ID match, title token overlap)
notes: Trained on 65 rows (65 from a 2026-09-16 rapid-review session, 1 pre-existing) — far below the project's 300+ threshold for a meaningful reranker. Not wired into src/lib/ml/reranker.ts. Weights: exactIdMatch=1.653, titleOverlapRatio=2.298, bias=0.117.

metrics.note: Train-set fit only, not a held-out evaluation -- 20 examples across 5 classes cannot support one.

notes: Fine-tuned offline in Python (scripts/ml-finetune/finetune_intent_classifier.py), base model distilbert-base-uncased (66M params, chosen for CPU feasibility -- no GPU in this environment, no LoRA of the 3B Ollama LLM is tractable here). NOT wired into src/lib/intent.ts or any runtime path -- this repo's own execution contract forbids a Python runtime inference service in the live app. Checkpoint exists purely as offline infrastructure/proof that the fine-tuning pipeline runs end-to-end on real data, not as a production capability.
